acme-corp (Integrations): Hey team — around 09:12 UTC we're seeing production EU requests suddenly returning low-capability outputs and tokenization errors. Example reply has garbled tokens and missing sections. :confused:

sara (Support): Sorry about that, can you paste a sample request_id and the model field from the response headers?

acme-corp (Integrations): request_id=rid_20260315_ABC123, response headers show: model=redwood-rose-3b-lite, region=eu-west-1, routed_from=us-west-2-failover. body snippet:

```
{"id":"rid_20260315_ABC123","choices":[{"text":"def func(x):\\n\\tprint(Ã©rror)\\n"}]}
```

miguel (Oncall): Hmm looks like a failover to a lite variant in a different region. Any 429s or latency spikes in metrics around that time?

acme-corp (Integrations): Latency spiked to 1.8s median then ~400ms after failover; no 5xx. Only behavioral regression: simpler reasoning and broken non-ASCII characters.

tara (ML Eng): That garbled character is consistent with a tokenizer vocab mismatch between main and lite variants. Lite model likely uses a different tokenizer config. Can you repro with curl against eu endpoint and force the fallback path?

acme-corp (Integrations): repro steps we used:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" -d '{"model":"redwood-rose-3b","input":"def func(x): print(\'error\')\\n"}'
2) Repeat until routing shows routed_from header

Response when routed to lite variant:
```
{"model":"redwood-rose-3b-lite","choices":[{"text":"def func(x):\\n\\tprint(Ã©rror)\\n"}]}
```

sara (Support): OK we'll escalate. @niko can you check the fallback pool config for eu-west-1? Looks like lite variants were incorrectly marked compatible with full model family.

niko (Eng Runtime): On it. Quick summary: autoscaler introduced a broadened compatibility tag 'family:rose' that matched both 'redwood-rose-3b' and 'redwood-rose-3b-lite' for failover. That's a bug — lite shouldn't be in the same capability group. Rolling back the tag now and pushing a hotfix to routing rules.

infra-bot: Deploy started: rollback-routing-tags-2026-03-15 by niko — CI job #9452

miguel (Oncall): Immediate mitigation for customers: set model pin in request: "model":"redwood-rose-3b:v2" or set header "X-Prefer-Exact-Model: true". Also enable region pinning with tenant config until fix is live.

acme-corp (Integrations): Thanks — we pinned the model and the output looks correct again. Reproduced the bad behavior twice before pinning.

tara (ML Eng): Follow-up: we'll add a tokenizer-compatibility check to the routing tests to detect mismatched vocab or special token encodings. Also schedule a postmortem for the policy change.

sara (Support): I'll update the support ticket and mark as escalated->eng-runtime. Next steps: confirm hotfix deployed and monitor routing metrics for 24h. :white_check_mark:

acme-corp (Integrations): Appreciate the quick turnaround — please keep us posted on root cause and whether billing or auth were involved (no billing alerts on our side so far).

niko (Eng Runtime): Hotfix deployed, rollback complete. No auth or billing impact detected. Creating internal bug: RUNTIME-2189.

sara (Support): Closing the thread after 24h stable — will re-open if customer sees regression. :eyes:
